title: Parse Server 2.5.0 before 8.6.121 and 9.0.0 before 9.11.1-alpha.1 does not handle a failure to serialize an object…
description: Parse Server versions 2.5.0 before 8.6.121 and 9.0.0 before 9.11.1-alpha.1 contain a vulnerability where failure to serialize an object after a beforeSave trigger is not handled properly. This can cause the server process to terminate, resulting in a denial of service. A remote attacker who can update an object in a class with a beforeSave trigger can exploit this by sending a dot notation key below a non-object field, such as a timestamp, to crash the server for all clients.
